mechanism: Propranolol inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of haloperidol, increasing haloperidol plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity; both drugs have additive effects on cardiac conduction and CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, QT prolongation, hypotension); consider haloperidol dose reduction or alternative antipsychotic; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs.
